original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Prove the sharp nine-line rational three-total anchor-box floor six, with the sharp seven-line floor five as a direct corollary, under nonzero diagonal and canonical tau>=1. The underlying rank-three matrix lemmas hold over any field.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first continuation of PR3409 after refreshing canonical main and priority revision6, replaying the card baseline, and checking complete current and historical PR/Discussion snapshots. The initially proposed two-disjoint-triples condition fails on diag(J5,J2,J2); permitting a four-plus-two alternative supplies the intended six-line witness.
bottleneck_link: Closes the next floor(2v/3) threshold in the tau>=1 anchor-box route, with a restriction corollary at ten lines. This is not admission of the full F-star supplier and does not change the selected kappa.
stop_rule: Structural checkpoint after approximately 20 minutes; finish with a scoped proof/counterexample or exact reusable obstruction within approximately 60 minutes. No unstructured directed-zero census.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the six-row dichotomy, seven-row ordered-triple consequence, and nine-row two-basis exchange proof. The source-authenticated exact controls and independent oracle replay finite constructions; they are not premises replacing the analytic theorem.
author: Sagar Thakrar, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate proof, exact-control and independent-review agents. Same-session AI reviews are not independent human acceptance or formal proof.

open_questions.question: Do eleven rational three-total lines with nonzero diagonal and tau>=1 always have box>=7?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This is the next floor(2v/3) threshold after the nine-line theorem and its ten-line restriction corollary.
open_questions.first_step: Begin with the (4,4,3) duplication of the PR2978 core. An ordered nonzero four-block together with the seven-row triple lemma suffices; inspect whether rank three forces such a four-block or whether additional anchor information is necessary.
open_questions.blocked_by: The nine-row exchange argument supplies only six retained rows. It does not prove the needed larger block or handle all eleven-row zero patterns.

open_questions.question: Is the eight-line floor five sharp, or must every admitted eight-line configuration have box>=6?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The seven-line result is sharp at five, while the balanced eight-line core duplication has box six; neither settles the intervening sharp threshold.
open_questions.first_step: Study two, rather than three, cross-intersecting H families over the six-row pair of diagonal bases; keep failed sufficient matrix conditions separate from actual box counterexamples.
open_questions.blocked_by: Two edge families may be complementary two-edge matchings, so the three-family argument does not directly force a singleton or common center.
